Rae: Quick check 1: planning a short 2-email nudgeblast for the benchmark launch: teaser (announce webinar + report) and follow-up (record + TL;DR). Need lists split + send windows.

Ibrahim: I can split lists. Proposed cohorts: trial_users, api_explorers, newsletter_only. Send windows: NA 12pm PT, EU 10am CET, APAC 10am SGT.

Nora: I'll do subject lines A/B. Short set for APAC. Starting options:
- "Benchmark: Faster, Cheaper LLM Inference"
- "Webinar + Report: Serving LLMs in Prod"

Cal: HubSpot notes: add hidden field cohort and utm params. Routing: cohort=trial_users -> SDR_High; demo=true -> webhook /hooks/demo. Ill build flows after lists.

June: QA plan: test send to staging list, validate UTMs, webhook firing, and unsubscribe link. QA window = 24h after templates ready.

Rae: CSV naming: `bench_wave{n}_{cohort}.csv`. Required cols: email,first_name,cohort,consent. Example: `ali@acme.com,Ali,trial_users,true`.

Ibrahim: Uploaded wave1 to gs://marketing/bench/w1_trial_NA.csv :white_check_mark:

Nora: I'll push templates to docs and flag strings for APAC truncation.

Cal: Retarget rule: opened but no click -> send record in follow-up. Exports nightly to s3://exports/bench/retarget.csv.

Rae: Targets: trial open >=28%, CTR >=6%. Daily summary at 9am PT for first 3 days. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
